start: Workout open on the phone with watch logging; next set Bench Press 62.5 kg × 8

user_sees: Next-set screen: the name, "Set 2 of 4", pills "62.5" and "8", and the first time "Tap a number, then turn the dial"
must_not: Pills with "—" when the phone sent numbers

steps.action: Tap the reps pill and turn the dial two steps
user_sees: "Turn the dial · 1 rep steps"
Reps 10, one light tick per step

"Saved" for about 2 seconds when the phone confirms

start: Last set of an exercise on the next-set screen

user_sees: One set sent
must_not: Two sets saved on the phone

user_sees: "Rest is over" about 5 seconds, then the exercise-done screen, then the next exercise
must_not: A blank screen after "Rest is over"
